scope: Review one e-commerce short video using video/product evidence fields plus is_AIGC. The workflow covers only the 15 user-confirmed SOP issue types, does not cover the complete SOP, and does not use review or feedback fields.

frame_sampling_contract.frame_list_semantics: frame_list contains up to 8 video frames uniformly sampled across the full video duration in chronological order.
frame_sampling_contract.adjacent_frame_semantics: Adjacent video frames mean neighboring sampled frames in frame_list, not frames one second apart.
frame_sampling_contract.timestamp_boundary: Do not claim exact elapsed time between frames unless explicit timestamps are provided.

is_AIGC_usage.must_not_trigger_issue_by_itself: is_AIGC is only an attribute and attention signal. It must never create a hit without concrete frame, ASR, OCR, or product image evidence.

rules.name: Potential pirated or suspicious spliced/remixed content
triggers: Video frames show frequent clip switching with different people, hands, scenery, lighting, resolution, aspect ratio, or production styles that strongly suggest multi-source splicing.
Video frames show sandwich-style or AB-style composition that appears to combine unrelated source footage with product promotion.
Video frames or ASR/OCR suggest domestic-seller or other-creator footage was repurposed for a European e-commerce promotion.
required_evidence: strong internal evidence from video frames, ASR, or OCR
specific frame-level or text-level evidence explaining why ordinary montage is unlikely
no external Pearl fields are required or available; judge only from current workflow inputs
false_positive_boundaries: Do not mark potential_pirated for ordinary editing, normal montage, scene transitions, product b-roll, or weak style changes.
Do not mark potential_pirated when the footage could reasonably be authorized brand or seller material and there is no strong internal evidence of repurposed content.
Do not rely on external Pearl Similar Video, creator profile, account ownership, or penalty record because these fields are not part of the workflow input.

rules.sop_label: Irrelevant promotion//内容与商品无关（IP问题）
rules.name: Video content unrelated to bound product promotion
triggers: Video content is mainly entertainment, storytelling, social content, accident footage, or unrelated scenes.
The bound product appears only briefly, flashes by, cannot be clearly identified, or is not meaningfully promoted.
ASR/OCR/title-style evidence indicates the main content topic is unrelated to the product.
required_evidence: video frame evidence or ASR/OCR evidence showing main content topic
product reference evidence or product identity showing what the bound product is
false_positive_boundaries: Do not mark irrelevant_promotion when the video clearly demonstrates, explains, or uses the bound product even briefly but substantively.
Do not mark irrelevant_promotion only because the video contains entertainment elements if the product remains the central promotion target.

rules.name: Confirmed non-original or copied creator content
triggers: Video frame shows visible third-party creator watermark, username, platform mark, repost mark, or copied-source indicator.
ASR/OCR clearly indicates reposting, copying, stolen content, or content taken from another creator.
A duet-like layout shows the current creator contributes no meaningful new product promotion and only carries another creator's product promotion.
required_evidence: strong internal evidence from video frames, ASR, or OCR
specific evidence identifying copied or third-party creator content
no external Pearl fields are required or available; judge only from current workflow inputs
false_positive_boundaries: Do not mark pirated_content for ordinary montage, public-resource footage, or likely authorized brand/seller material without strong internal evidence.
Do not rely on external Pearl Similar Video, creator profile, account ownership, or penalty record because these fields are not part of the workflow input.

rules.sop_label: Inconsistent product promotion//挂车商品与讲解商品不一致
rules.name: Promoted product differs from bound product
triggers: Video contains verbal or written e-commerce product promotion.
The displayed product differs materially from the bound product shown in product reference images.
Mismatch concerns product type, shape, structure, packaging, material, style, size, variant, or core design.
required_evidence: video frame or ASR/OCR evidence of the promoted product
product reference images for comparison
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit when displayed product matches the bound product main image.
Do not hit when the displayed item can reasonably be a SKU variant of the bound product.
For blind boxes, accessories, jade, and collectible cards, same L3 category can exempt the mismatch.
For apparel tops and bottoms, pattern or color differences within the same SPU/SKU family can be exempted.
If product images are missing, do not make a strong hit; use manual_review if text or frames are concerning.

rules.name: Non-native content style for international market
triggers: Creator uses long Chinese spoken expression in an international-market product promotion.
Video contains Chinese characters in text, stickers, or background while promoting in an international market.
Spoken English is highly unusual, incomprehensible, or has severe grammar/expression issues that block understanding.
required_evidence: ASR, OCR, or visible frame text/language evidence
country or market context when available
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for slight accent when the content remains intelligible.
Do not hit for isolated non-local background speech that is not the creator's promotion.
This workflow covers non_native only; it does not cover the broader SOP Other Languages category.

rules.name: Static-frame video without product explanation
triggers: Video has no verbal or written product explanation.
Product display is made of static images, live photos, screenshots, cutouts, or pasted product images.
The content lacks real video footage or meaningful live demonstration.
required_evidence: video frame evidence showing static or pasted visual format
ASR/OCR absence or lack of product explanation
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit when the video has a meaningful real demonstration, even if some static slides are present.
Do not hit from missing ASR/OCR alone if frames show clear product use or demonstration.

rules.sop_label: Out-of-app transactions//商家引流站外交易
rules.name: Off-platform transaction guidance
triggers: Content includes an external payment or transaction route such as PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, WhatsApp, Telegram, phone number, external website, offline store, or other payment app.
Content directs viewers to purchase, pay, contact, or complete the transaction through that external route.
Evidence can come from ASR, OCR, or visual signage in video frames.
required_evidence: external transaction route
commercial or purchase direction tied to that route
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit when the content only promotes social media or messaging contact and commercial intent is unclear.
Do not hit when the host clearly directs users to order inside TTS and external mention is incidental.
Do not hit for external contact aimed only at users who cannot access the TTS shopping cart unless commercial evasion is explicit.

rules.sop_label: Misleading functionality and effect//虚假夸大
rules.name: Misleading or exaggerated functionality and effect
triggers: Video magnifies product effects or functions using exaggerated filming or unreliable information.
Product result appears physically, medically, biologically, or practically unreliable.
Video claims rapid or guaranteed outcomes for health, beauty, weight, growth, repair, cleaning, durability, capacity, compatibility, or safety without credible support.
required_evidence: ASR/OCR claim or visual demonstration showing the exaggerated effect
connection to the promoted product expectation
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for normal positive marketing praise without concrete misleading effect or function.
Do not hit just because is_AIGC is true; non-AIGC content can also be misleading and AIGC content can be acceptable.

rules.sop_label: Dangerous behavior//危害人身安全及危险行为
rules.name: Dangerous behavior or life-safety risk
triggers: Video includes violent or unsafe behavior that endangers life safety.
Product demonstration encourages dangerous imitation.
Product or demonstration creates the illusion of fire, heavy smoke, explosion, weapon-like harm, or unsafe operation.
required_evidence: video frame evidence or ASR/OCR evidence of dangerous behavior
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for ordinary safe product use.
Do not hit for fictional or decorative danger cues unless they create a realistic safety risk or unsafe promotional instruction.

rules.sop_label: Disgusting and terrifying//恶心恐怖（画面引起不适）
rules.name: Disgusting, terrifying, or physically uncomfortable content
triggers: Video shows ear cleaning, close-up insects, dirty drains, sewers, dirty or messy places, bodily material, or other visuals likely to cause discomfort.
Audio includes sudden screams, harsh terrifying sounds, or sounds that are physically uncomfortable.
The discomfort is central enough to affect the viewer experience.
required_evidence: video frame evidence, ASR/OCR, or explicit audio-description evidence
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for ordinary cleaning-product scenarios where the environment is mildly dirty but acceptable.
Do not hit for minor background noise that does not prevent clear hearing.

rules.sop_label: Description is not detailed//内容介绍不详细 & 低质
rules.name: Product description lacks required detail
triggers: Video contains product promotion but lacks enough product explanation.
For most products, the product is not clearly and fully displayed and the explanation lacks meaningful information.
For electric products, digital products, skincare products, or health supplements, the product is not both displayed and explained.
required_evidence: video frame evidence of product display quality
ASR/OCR evidence showing missing or weak product explanation
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for most products when they are shown clearly and fully, even with limited narration.
Do not hit for makeup get-ready-with-me videos, card unboxing/break videos, or party board game intro videos when the SOP exemption conditions are met.
Do not confuse this with only_marketing_sales_pitches; this label covers insufficient product detail beyond pure hard-sell scripts.

rules.sop_label: Only marketing sales pitches//仅营销叫卖
rules.name: Only hard-sell marketing pitches
triggers: ASR/OCR only emphasizes price, discount, gifts, promotion ending, stock pressure, urgency, checkout, cart, or purchase guidance.
Text or speech does not explain product function, specification, usage effect, usage method, material, compatibility, or scenario.
This rule applies to all product categories.
required_evidence: ASR/OCR evidence showing hard-sell content
absence of substantive product explanation in ASR/OCR
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit when there is weak but real product function, usage, specification, material, or scenario information.
Do not hit from missing ASR/OCR alone.

rules.name: Sexualized or vulgar perception
triggers: Content contains unnecessary exposure or sexually suggestive actions such as chest shaking, bending over to expose cleavage, prominent genital outlines, or intentionally sexualized body display.
The product itself reveals a high degree of skin exposure and wearing or display can easily expose sensitive body parts.
Presentation creates pornography perception rather than ordinary product introduction.
required_evidence: video frame evidence or ASR/OCR evidence of sexualized presentation
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for ordinary introduction, display, or description of intimate products without private-part nudity and without sexually suggestive conduct.
Regular bikini use in an appropriate beach context is not enough by itself.

rules.sop_label: No physical product display//无实物展示（但确实围绕商品讲）
rules.name: Product is promoted but not physically displayed
triggers: Video contains verbal or written product explanation.
The product is shown only as stickers, cutouts, photos, screenshots, live images, or webpage imagery without real video footage.
The product is not shown at all, or only a partial view is shown so the bound product cannot be confirmed.
The bound product includes package or brand, but the video only shows the result or usage outcome without package or brand evidence.
required_evidence: ASR/OCR or visual evidence that the content is about the product
frame evidence that no physical product is shown or only non-video/static representation is shown
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit if the physical product is clearly shown and can be recognized.
Do not hit when there is no product explanation; consider still_frame or irrelevant_promotion instead depending on evidence.

rules.name: Unrealistic visual physics or continuity error
triggers: Video frames show objects morphing, clipping, floating, moving on their own, passing through surfaces, or changing geometry unrealistically.
Video frames show product identity drift, structure drift, pattern drift, content identity drift, impossible scale or pose change, or object materialization.
Garbled or morphing product text/logo appears in a way that affects product understanding.
AIGC video shows fake speech, fake interview, impossible before-after effects, unrealistic product size/style/effect, or AI avatar explaining the product without product appearance.
For transparent storage boxes, drawers, organizers, or containers, the same compartment contents change between adjacent sampled frames without a visible placement action.
required_evidence: specific video frame evidence
when is_AIGC is true, still require concrete frame evidence; the attribute only raises attention
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit because is_AIGC is true by itself.
Do not over-focus on minor artifacts that do not affect product understanding.
Do not claim exact elapsed time between frames without timestamps.
Adjacent frames mean neighboring sampled frames in frame_list, not one second apart.

data_availability_rules: If frame_list is empty, do not make video-frame visual claims.
If images is empty or invalid, do not make product-image comparison claims.
If ASR and OCR are empty, do not make spoken or written text claims.
If evidence is suspicious but incomplete, prefer manual_review over a direct hit.
Do not use external Pearl fields, Similar Video tab, creator profile, account ownership, or penalty records.
output_rules: Use Chinese summary and evidence explanations.
Use only the 15 in-scope issue types plus none.
primary_issue_type must be one of detected_issue_types when overall_decision is problematic.
primary_issue_type must be none when overall_decision is clean.
Every hit or uncertain result must include concrete evidence.
is_AIGC must be returned as true, false, or unknown.
